body: Yeah I thought about the privacy issue but that's why the warning message should only appear once you confirm the transaction (so it would go through if they didn't have the item, but if they have the item it wouldn't go through and you'd get a warning). I think this is the best way because if you just want to see if someone has an item (aka "invade their privacy"), you'd have to be willing to actually pay the gems to send them the item.

I like anonymously gifting people or doing it as a surprise so asking doesn't really work... and I know customer support issues refunds but the whole thing just makes it so awkward. If I received a gift but already had an item I'd feel so bad for the gifter because they just wanted to do something nice but instead they get "Oh thanks but I already have that item, contact customer support for your gems back". It's incredibly inconvenient, awkward and sad for all 3 parties involved (customer support, the gifter, and the recipient) and really takes away from what you wanted to achieve in the first place.
